name: wyss-apps
description: Look up Wyss Institute projects, people and the costing-change queue as yourself.
long_description: Connects Claude to Wyss Apps (wigt.med.harvard.edu) with your own personal access token. Claude sees exactly what you can see in Wyss Apps and cannot change anything. Create a token at https://wigt.med.harvard.edu/tools/claude_access. Works only on the Wyss/HMS network or VPN.
